items.title: Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20
items.summary:
Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20 years of HN to 6,454 videos that keep being recommended. *Significantly* better viewing experience, ~2 hours with Opus 5.5:
https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Excellent recs without any logins (state is kept in local browser session)
- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.

items.title: Nvidia investigates reports CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by Chinese spy | AP News
items.summary:
Add AP News on Google  Add AP News as your preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Share 

 — Nvidia is opening an investigation into reports that CEO Jensen Huang was the “target of a foreign intelligence effort,” the company’s board of directors said Sunday.

The announcement came after Huang acknowledged to the board that he had been intimate with a business executive whom U.S. intelligence determined was gathering information for Beijing, The New York Times reported. [...] Huang apologized in a message to the company, according to the Times. “I was unfaithful to my wife,” he said. “My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry.”

Nvidia’s board said in a statement it has “no reason to believe that either national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised,” but that its inquiry would examine all available information. Huang “fully supports the review and has committed to cooperating with it,” the board said.

items.title: Nvidia stock falls amid probe into CEO’s relationship with Chinese spy
items.summary:
By Steve Kopack and Rob Wile

Nvidia’s stock slid about 4% on Monday after the company announced that it had opened an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with a woman that U.S. intelligence agencies say is a Chinese spy.

The probe has the potential to unsettle the entire AI boom, fueled by trillions of dollars of spending and investments, in part to purchase Nvidia’s cutting-edge AI chips. Nvidia’s drop wiped out more than $200 billion in value. [...] Nvidia’s peers, such as AMD, Qualcomm, Taiwan Semi and Intel, all rose along with the broader market. Nvidia was the biggest loser on the Dow, the Nasdaq 100 and S&P 500.

With so many outstanding questions about the Huang scandal, few major analysts that cover Nvidia had weighed in on Monday morning about what it could mean for the company’s future.

But those who did said it was a blemish on an otherwise sterling track record, which could spark even more investigations. [...] “A committee of independent directors, assisted by outside independent counsel, will oversee the investigation,” Nvidia said in a Sunday statement. “The Board prioritizes U.S. national and economic security, which is paramount to the interests of NVIDIA and its shareholders.”

An Nvidia spokesperson told NBC News that Huang was “committed to continuing to lead NVIDIA as CEO without interruption.”

items.title: Nvidia's shares slide as chip giant probes CEO over spy claims | Reuters
items.summary:
SEOUL/SYDNEY, Nov 9 (Reuters) - Nvidia (NVDA.O) shares tumbled on Monday after an internal investigation into whether CEO Jensen Huang had been targeted by a foreign intelligence effort ​put his future at the AI chipmaker under scrutiny. [...] Nvidia's shares tumbled around 8% in early trading, extending last week's selloff and pushing the stock to fresh multi-month lows. At the current levels, the chipmaker would lose around $350 billion in value from its last ​closing price.

"The market's probably telling you now this does no favors to the stock whatsoever in a time when there's a lot of conjecture as to the build-out of data centers," said Chris Weston, head of research at brokerage Pepperstone in ​Melbourne. [...] He is Nvidia's fifth-largest shareholder with a roughly 3.6% stake, according to LSEG data, and keeps a tight grip on the company through an unusually ​flat structure in which dozens of executives report directly to him.

But unlike Meta Platforms (META.O) or SpaceX (SPCX.O), Nvidia has no dual-class shares that would give its co-founder majority voting control.

items.summary:
Một số chuyên gia cho rằng các công ty trung tm dữ liệu mới nổi có thể gặp khó khăn về vốn nếu các quy định chặt chẽ hơn làm chậm tiến độ các dự án xy dựng mới. Các công ty này đã dựa vào khoản vay để mở rộng kinh doanh.  
   
Nguồn tin thị trường cho biết điều đó có nghĩa là cổ phiếu công nghệ có thể vẫn bất ổn trong thời gian trước mắt. [...] Chiến thắng áp đảo của đảng Dn chủ trong cuộc bầu cử giữa kỳ của Mỹ đã làm dấy lên lo ngại về triển vọng của ngành trí tuệ nhn tạo và bán dẫn. Điều này khiến cổ phiếu công nghệ cao của Mỹ biến động.  
   
Đảng Dn chủ đã giành lại quyền kiểm soát cả hai viện Quốc hội trong cuộc bầu cử tuần trước. Các ứng viên đảng Dn chủ cũng chiến thắng trong các cuộc bầu cử thống đốc ở nhiều bang, trong đó có Texas, nơi có nhiều trung tm dữ liệu. [...] Một số nhà đầu tư lo ngại những chiến thắng này có thể dẫn đến việc siết chặt quy định đối với AI và các trung tm dữ liệu.  
   
Mối lo này đã gy ra làn sóng bán tháo cổ phiếu bán dẫn và các cổ phiếu khác liên quan đến AI. Hôm thứ Năm, chỉ số Nasdaq gồm nhiều cổ phiếu công nghệ ở New York giảm hơn 5%. Cổ phiếu công nghệ đã phần nào khôi phục vào ngày hôm sau nhưng các nhà đầu tư vẫn thận trọng.

items.title: Đưa công nghệ đến gần hơn với người yếu thế
items.summary:
Cán bộ hướng dẫn công dân thao tác trên hệ thống dịch vụ công

Không chỉ hỗ trợ người dân hoàn thành thủ tục, cán bộ, chiến sĩ còn cố gắng sử dụng những cách giải thích đơn giản, dễ hiểu để người dân có thể tự thực hiện trong những lần tiếp theo. Đối với những người gặp khó khăn khi sử dụng công nghệ, cán bộ sẵn sàng hướng dẫn nhiều lần, giải đáp từng thắc mắc với thái độ tận tình, trách nhiệm. [...] Đối với những người thường xuyên sử dụng công nghệ, việc tạo tài khoản dịch vụ công, quét mã QR hoặc tải tài liệu đính kèm có thể thực hiện nhanh chóng. Tuy nhiên, với người cao tuổi và những người ít có điều kiện tiếp xúc với thiết bị điện tử, các thao tác này đôi khi gặp nhiều khó khăn.

Nhận thức được điều đó, cán bộ, chiến sĩ Công an xã Thuận An luôn chú trọng hướng dẫn cụ thể, kiên nhẫn giải thích từng bước để người dân hiểu và thực hiện đúng các thao tác cần thiết. [...] Những hoạt động hỗ trợ tuy giản dị nhưng mang ý nghĩa thiết thực, góp phần giúp người dân thuận lợi hơn trong giải quyết thủ tục hành chính, tiết kiệm thời gian, chi phí đi lại và từng bước nâng cao kỹ năng sử dụng dịch vụ công trực tuyến. Qua đó, Công an xã Thuận An tiếp tục đưa công nghệ đến gần hơn với người dân, nhất là những người còn gặp khó khăn trong tiếp cận công nghệ, để mọi người đều có cơ hội thụ hưởng những tiện ích của chuyển đổi số.

items.title: THIS IS ACTUAL F*CKING GOLD
items.summary:
THIS IS ACTUAL F*CKING GOLD

Anthropic just shared one of the best tricks for Claude Code.

The idea: run Sonnet, Haiku and Opus 5.5 together, each one doing only the job it's best at.

Opus-level judgment on every big call, without paying Opus rates for every routine turn.

You just launch Claude Code like this:

claude --model sonnet --advisor opus

here's the split:

→ Sonnet 5.5 runs the session and writes the code
→ Haiku 5.5 explores files and docs in parallel
→ Opus 5.5 stays on call as advisor for the big calls
→ you stop spending Opus on work that doesn't need it

Opus only steps in at three moments:

→ before a plan locks
→ when the same error shows up twice
→ before calling it done

Sonnet builds. Haiku explores. Opus reviews.

JEV engineering is the same move one layer down: the forks that need no thinker (which file, which tool, retry or stop) go to JEV in milliseconds, and the big models only see the ones that split

the full tree
> Sonnet 5.5 runs the main session and edits code
> search maps the repo on Haiku 5.5
> grep finds call sites on Haiku 5.5
> docs pulls the API reference on Haiku 5.5
> Opus 5.5 on call as advisor, reads the whole transcript when consulted
> JEV routes micro-forks in milliseconds

paste the tree and this prompt into Claude Code ↓

"Rebuild my Claude Code setup around this tree:
1. Run the main session on Sonnet 5.5 with Opus 5.5 as advisor.
2. Create three read-only Haiku 5.5 subagents: search (maps the repo), grep (finds call sites), docs (pulls the API reference).
3. Add one rule to CLAUDE.md: consult the advisor before locking a plan, after the same error twice, and before calling a task done.
4. Route fast deterministic forks (tool choice, path selection, retries) through JEV.
Show me every change as a diff first. No edits until I say go."

↳ https://t.co/bsYb2K5H9G

save it, you'll use this every single day.

Elon musk, on lex fridman last month: "anyone not running a swarm of agents by the end of 2026 will look like someone who refused to use email in 1998"

this is what he meant, in one screen recording:

one guy. 50 claude agents. a full working system shipped in 30 minutes. he did not write a single line of code. he gave the orders and watched them execute in parallel, each one handling a different piece of the build

meanwhile 90% of people reading this are still using claude the same fucking way they used chatgpt in 2023. one chat window. one task at a time. asking the same question in the same thread until it finally gets it right

the setup costs you one evening to learn and pays back forever. whoever learns it this month will be running 10x what their coworkers ship by january. the ones who do not will still be slow-typing into a blank chat like it is still 2023

i wrote the full breakdown of how the 50-agent setup works, what each agent is told to do, and the exact claude code config behind it. the article is below

the gap between the person who runs agents and the person who runs chats is about to become the only gap that matters. do not land on the wrong side of it
